name: tododesk-monorepo
description: TodoDesk —— Mac 桌面待办事项 + 学习计划 + 打卡应用，含 MCP 接口

scripts.test:mcp: npm run build:mcp && vitest run apps/mcp/test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mcp --noEmit
scripts.build:desktop: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build:web && node apps/desktop/scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm run help:sync && cd apps/desktop && npx vite build
scripts.plugin:build: npm run build:mcp && cp apps/mcp/dist/mcp-server.cjs apps/plugin/mcp/mcp-server.cjs
